text: I am round and have no beginning or end. I represent infinity and completeness. What am I?
I am the king of the jungle, with a majestic mane. I roar loudly to mark my territory. What am I?
I am yellow and curved. Monkeys love me, and I grow in bunches. What am I?
I am white and cold. I fall from the sky in winter and cover the ground. What am I?
I am a giant ball of hot gas that gives light and warmth to Earth. What am I?
I am the fastest land animal. I have spots and can run at incredible speeds. What am I?
I am red and round. You can eat me fresh or make sauce from me. What am I?
I am a precious metal, shiny and yellow. I am used in jewelry and coins. What am I?
I am the largest mammal in the ocean. I sing songs and can be heard from miles away. What am I?
I am tall and have leaves at the top. Birds nest in me and I provide shade. What am I?
I am invisible but you can feel me. I blow and make leaves dance. What am I?
I am always hungry and must be fed. I turn everything I touch into ash. What am I?
I am full of keys but can't open any door. Musicians play me. What am I?
I am the force that keeps you on the ground and makes things fall down. What am I?
I am transparent and wet. Fish live in me, and I cover most of the Earth. What am I?
I am the smallest unit of life. I am the building block of all living things. What am I?
I am a large continent known for my kangaroos and koalas. What am I?
I am the tallest mountain on Earth. Climbers seek to reach my peak. What am I?
I am the capital of France, known for my Eiffel Tower. What am I?
I am the red planet in our solar system. Scientists search for life on me. What am I?
I am made of many colours and appear after rain when the sun shines. What am I?
I am black and white and loved in China. I eat bamboo all day. What am I?
I am frozen water that floats. Ships fear hitting me in the ocean. What am I?
I am the closest star to Earth. I rise in the east and set in the west. What am I?
I am carved on Halloween and grow in patches. What am I?
I am the longest river in the world, flowing through Africa. What am I?
I am sweet and sticky. Bees make me from flower nectar. What am I?
I am the largest organ in the human body. I protect you from harm. What am I?
I am the powerhouse of the cell. I produce energy. What am I?
I am a natural phenomenon where the ground shakes. I can cause great destruction. What am I?
I am the study of the stars and planets. Astronomers practice me. What am I?
I am a large grey animal with a trunk. I never forget. What am I?
I am the process by which plants make food using sunlight. What am I?
I am a giant wave caused by underwater earthquakes. What am I?
I am the imaginary line that divides Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres. What am I?
I am a white crystalline substance that makes food taste better. Too much of me is unhealthy. What am I?
